name: codec-aac-parametric-stereo-560f2225
reason: AAC Parametric Stereo from open publications and probes: the recovery of the PS syntax, Huffman books, SBR_F_ENVBAL30 and every signal table and rule by scripted probes of FFmpeg 9.0.2, with the notes and probes of both passes and the source texts; the table generator's write and --check runs from empty work directories; the aac lane's gates for 560f2225 and 339ec261 on AArch64 and in the ARMv7 user space (crate tests, fate_vectors with AAC_REF_DIR, per-vector numbers, conformance s16, codecs grade), the equivalence records and the three open cases on both builds and targets; instruction counts of the PS, HE-AAC and frozen AAC-LC workloads against 339ec261 on both targets; the scripts that ran them.
